name: Tape measure
summary: A steel tape pulls out of the case to measure, a thumb slide holds it out, and it winds itself back in when released.

parts.name: Case
parts.role: The plastic shell you hold, with the coiled tape inside.

parts.name: Tape
parts.role: The curved steel blade marked with lengths.

parts.name: End hook
parts.role: The metal tab on the end that catches on an edge.

parts.name: Thumb lock
parts.role: A slide on the front that holds the tape where it is.

parts.name: Belt clip
parts.role: A steel clip on the back.
